summary: Unmocked end-to-end MCP tools/call and resources/read requests carry all six configured tokens (including opaque grammar-edge values) through the real mounted SDK with caplog at DEBUG, plus token-bearing records injected through the pinned mcp.server.fastmcp.server/mcp.server.lowlevel.server loggers via message args, extra, traceback, and stack_info; assertions scan rendered text, raw record __dict__ reprs, a late-attached handler stream, and response bodies for every token with a [redacted] sentinel guarding vacuity — verified falsifiable: disabling the production redaction installer in-process makes the test fail.
